experience.title: ML Intern
experience.description: Engineered AI/ML optimization models for 2 industrial biorefinery processes integrating process modeling, data analytics, and domain expertise. Built Deep ANN (8-10-1, TF/Keras) for bioethanol yield prediction achieving Val R2> 0.96 and Test R2≈ 0.92. Implemented RF, SVR, Gradient Boosting ensembles with cross-validation, improving lactic acid recovery yield by ∼12% at industrial scale. Performed ANN techno-economic optimization enabling +1.0°GL alcohol gain and INR ∼74L/year in projected cost savings.

experience.title: Summer Intern

Designed 3+ data visualization dashboards to surface payment trends, delays, and anomalies, cutting manual review time for the finance team. Automated recurring workflows using Python scripts and documentation, reducing processing time across 5+ operational task categories.

projects.name: Agentic Deep-Research Copilot
projects.description: Developed an AI-based research assistant using FastAPI and LangGraph for multi-step reasoning and citation-grounded retrieval across 10+ sources. Architected a document processing pipeline with semantic chunking and ChromaDB and SQLAlchemy embeddings, cutting retrieval latency by ∼30%. Containerized the application using Streamlit, RESTful APIs, and Docker for modular deployment, reducing environment setup time to under 5 minutes.

projects.name: Online Retail Sales Analytics Dashboard
projects.description: Built an end-to-end ETL analytics pipeline using Python (Pandas), SQLite, and Power BI to analyze 1M+ transactions across 43 countries. Engineered a data cleaning and feature pipeline to remove invalid records and extract 15+ revenue and time-based features for analysis. Created 20 analytical SQL queries and a Power BI dashboard with KPIs, revenue trends, customer insights, and interactive filters.

projects.name: ASL Gesture Recognition (CNN)
projects.description: Trained a CNN to classify 24 ASL sign language gestures from image data, achieving 94% validation accuracy via batch normalization and dropout. Implemented a complete data preprocessing pipeline including reshaping, normalization, one-hot encoding, and structured dataset handling. Improved model performance using Adam optimizer, early stopping, and LR scheduling for overfitting prevention and robust generalization.
